notes.title: Free Exclusive Cabinet of Curiosities Promo T-Shirt for Patreon Supporters!
notes.notes:
As I'm working on the Cabinet of Curiosities VR room, I really wanted to thank you who have supported me through this. I work on this as I can, by myself, and I truly couldn't continue to work on these projects without your encouragement and support. So as a "thank you", I've decided to release an exclusive FREE t-shirt [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/exclusive-free-t-112427302?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_creator&utm_content=join_link]on my Patreon[/url] to those who want it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342699/1b6f0e294f326019b73d6a7140beeb3ca91b97e1.png[/img]

Please do tell a friend or two about the project! You can even come [url=https://vr.mechanicalwhispers.com/]explore the VR demo pre-release rooms[/url] with a friend or 20. :)

Thank you all again!
-Robert

notes.title: Steam Page is LIVE! Wishlist the Cabinet of Curiosities!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1986490/Cabinet_of_Curiosities_VR/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1986490/header.jpg?t=1671714810[/img][/url]
So excited to launch the Steam page for my Cabinet of Curiosities project. This has been 2 long years in the making. Please help spread the word, and get as many people to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1986490/Cabinet_of_Curiosities_VR/]wishlist[/url] before launch. Feel free to share the videos and screenshots I've posted. I want all curious minds out there to have the opportunity to enjoy this one-of-a-kind VR experience! Thank you!
-Robert
